description: For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.

a.request: For each archival status (`archstat`) in the QC data, with a missing status treated as its own group, count the distinct projects (`arcref`) that have QC records with that status. Work out each status's share as that count divided by the sum of the counts over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the count, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding.
a.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, cnt AS project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

c.request: In the QC data, tally the projects under each archival status (`archstat`), with a missing status treated as its own group. Work out each status's share as its tally divided by the sum of the tallies over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the tally, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding. For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.
c.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing')), s AS (SELECT status, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT status, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT status, cnt AS count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

b.request: For each archival status in the QC data (`scanqc.archstat`, with NULL treated as its own group), count the distinct projects (`arcref`) that have QC records with that status. Compute each status's share as its count divided by the sum of these counts across all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses, showing the status, the count, the share, and share minus average share, with no rounding
b.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, cnt AS project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

d.request: In the QC data, for each archival status (`archstat`), count the distinct projects that have QC records with that status, treating a missing status as its own group. Calculate each status's share as its count divided by the sum of these counts across all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. For each, show the status, the count, the share, and the share minus the average share, with no rounding.
d.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, cnt AS project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
